## 中文

- 发布流程改为自动构建完整产物（含 `mod.json` 与 `classes.dex`）并校验后上传，修复此前手动发布产物缺少 `mod.json` 的问题。

## English

- Release artifacts are now built automatically as full desktop+Android jars (with `mod.json` and `classes.dex`) and verified before upload, fixing previous manual releases that shipped without the mod descriptor.
